style: A minimalist question wall: Gloock set at poster scale on near white (or near black), Familjen Grotesk for everything else, one oversized orange question mark, and a wall of the questions clients bring where one is lit at a time.

concept.idea: Every research project starts as a question somebody cannot answer yet, so the site is built from questions: a wall of the ones clients bring, services as how they get answered, proof as the answers in clients' words, and contact as 'What is your question?'.
concept.signature: The question wall: six questions in Gloock, one lit at a time with an orange rule drawing above it and its question mark tipping, moving on every few seconds and following the pointer. Every question in full ink without JS or with reduced motion.
concept.motionVerb: ask: light up, tip, move on

jury.note: Self-score from the /jury rubric and shoot.mjs evidence (0 axe violations, no horizontal overflow at 390 or 1440 with sample and long.json, no tap target under 24 px, every focus stop visible, skip link first, nothing moving under reduced motion). No blind critic was run for this batch. The calmest and fastest page to read, with poster-scale Gloock and a single orange mark, in designed light and dark. Minimal by intent, so the idea rests on the question wall alone, and creativity is held at 7.
